product_title: Pink Lotus Shubh Labh Toran with Pearl Tassels (38 inches)
product_description: Welcome prosperity and festive charm into your home with this beautifully handcrafted toran. Featuring vibrant pink lotus motifs, traditional Shubh Labh accents, intricate golden detailing, and elegant pearl tassels, it is perfect for Diwali, pooja rooms, main entrances, and festive celebrations.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth.
Avoid water, moisture, and harsh chemicals.
Handle pearl tassels and decorative details carefully.
Store flat in a cool, dry place after use.
